specialRules.ruleFull: The warband may hold jezzails, warpfire throwers, warplock pistols and poison wind globes only while it has at least one Warlock Apprentice; with no Apprentice none of that equipment may be included. The Warlock Engineer is the exception: he may always buy it for his own use.
The warband may hold any number of Slaves, up to half the warband.
Clan Skryre warbands may visit the Skaven Armoury, the Clan Skryre Armoury and the Warlock's Inner Sanctum.
Any warrior within 6" of the Warlock Engineer may use his Leadership instead of his own.
A Warlock Engineer is a wizard and casts the Magic of the Horned Rat.
A Warlock Apprentice begins with no spells. When he rolls a new skill as an experience advance he may take a randomly determined spell instead of a skill.
Every spell a Warlock Apprentice casts counts as +1 difficulty.
When an Initiate group rolls "Lad's Got Talent", the promoted Initiate must take spells as one of his two skill lists, and the rules for Warlock Apprentices apply to him from then on.
A Slave may carry a shield, but may never wear a helmet or light armour.
When testing whether the warband must take a Rout test, each Slave taken out of action counts as half a model.
A Slave who rolls "Lad's Got Talent" is removed from the roster, whether or not the warband holds its full number of Heroes, and you roll for an advance again if his group has other members.

skillGroup.name: Skaven Clan Skryre (Athel Loren)
skillGroup.note: Infiltration: Stormvermin only. Skavenbrew Master: Warlock Engineers and Warlock Apprentices only.

specialSkillsList.name: Skavenbrew Master
specialSkillsList.description: One batch of skavenbrew bought per game may have its die roll for effect changed by +1 or -1, as though a slave had been sacrificed. This is not cumulative with sacrificing a slave: do one or the other, not both.

specialSkillsList.name: Warpstone Resistance
specialSkillsList.description: This Skaven is only stunned on a 5-6 when he swallows a chunk of warpstone, and takes a Strength 2 hit instead of the usual hit when a poison wind globe hits him for any reason. Skavenbrew no longer has any effect on him.

rules.text: A warplock jezzail takes a whole turn to reload, so the model may only fire it every other turn.
The model may not move and fire a warplock jezzail in the same turn, other than to pivot on the spot to face its target or to stand up.
Every shot fired from a jezzail is at -2 to hit. A jezzail support, carried by a second Initiate or Apprentice, removes that penalty.
A warrior wounded by a warplock jezzail takes his armour save with a -3 modifier.

rules.name: Random Range
rules.text: When a warpfire thrower is fired, work out its range and draw a straight line from the firer up to that distance. Every model within 1" of the line takes a single Strength 4 hit.
The model may not move and fire a warpfire thrower in the same turn, other than to pivot on the spot to face its target or to stand up.

rules.name: Dangerous
rules.text: If the roll for the distance the warpfire travels is a double, roll another D6: on a 5+ the warpfire is splattered over the crew instead of being fired, and is resolved as though their own weapon had hit them.

rules.name: Fuel Hungry
rules.text: A warpfire thrower may only be fired twice per battle. A warpfire barrel removes that limit.

rules.name: Heavy Armour
rules.text: Warpstone armour counts as heavy armour and grants a 5+ save. Being heavy armour, it takes 1 off the wearer's Movement if he also carries a shield.

rules.name: Magical
rules.text: A Skaven spellcaster wearing warpstone armour may still cast spells as usual.

rules.name: Steady Jezzail
rules.text: While a warrior with a jezzail support is in base contact with a warrior armed with a jezzail in the Shooting phase, the warrior firing the jezzail does not suffer the Difficult to use penalty.

rules.name: May Not Shoot
rules.text: A warrior using a jezzail support may not fire any other missile weapon he carries.

rules.name: Store Fuel
rules.text: While a warrior with a warpfire barrel is in base contact with a warrior armed with a warpfire thrower in the Shooting phase, that warpfire thrower is not limited to two shots per battle.

rules.name: Must Remain in Base Contact
rules.text: The warrior carrying the barrel must stay in base contact with the model holding the warpfire thrower. If the barrel bearer is killed, the warpfire thrower may fire twice more before it runs out of fuel. If a warpfire thrower's carrier is killed, the Skaven with the barrel may join another model armed with one. More barrels than warpfire throwers gain nothing.

rules.name: Unstable
rules.text: A model carrying a barrel may not move more than 5" in a turn, so he may not run and may charge only up to his normal Movement. If he is forced to move faster, roll a D6: on a 1 the barrel bursts and every model within D3+1", the bearer included, takes a Strength 4 hit. This may not be done deliberately. If a model carrying a barrel suffers a critical hit in close combat, roll a D6: on a 5+ the barrel explodes the same way, and the critical hit is then resolved as usual.

rules.name: Casting
rules.text: If a Warlock Engineer, and only a Warlock Engineer, swallows a shard of warpstone before casting a spell, that spell's difficulty is reduced by 2 for that casting. One use only.
Immediately after a warpstone shard is used, roll a D6: on a 4+ the Warlock Engineer is stunned. The spell's effects are worked out before the roll.

rules.name: Drug
rules.text:
Each batch is given to one warrior, who must be a Hero, and lasts a single game. Roll on the table for what it does.

D6 | Effect
5-6 | He is subject to the psychology rules for frenzy for the next battle.
3-4 | He hates all non-Skaven and is subject to the psychology rules for hatred for the next battle.
1-2 | The brew has no effect.

After a game in which a warrior used skavenbrew, roll 2D6: on a 2-3 he loses a point of Initiative for good, and if that would take his Initiative to 2 or below he suffers from stupidity instead. No roll is needed if the brew had no effect.

rules.name: Test Subject
rules.text: A Warlock Engineer may test a batch on a slave first. Roll a D6: on a 6 the slave is unharmed, otherwise remove him from the roster at once, dead. Whatever the roll, you may then add +1 or -1 to the D6 roll for the brew's effect.

rules.summary: Wounded models receive no armour save
rules.text: A model wounded by a poison wind globe receives no armour save.

rules.name: Template
rules.summary: Every model within 1" of the point hit takes a Strength 4 hit
rules.text: The globe bursts over a 1" template centred on the point hit, and every model under it, friend or foe, takes a single Strength 4 hit, so a model up to 7" from the thrower may be hit. If the throw misses, the template deviates D3" in a random direction from the point aimed at and is resolved where it lands.

rules.name: Fragile
rules.summary: A 1 on a D6 bursts a globe when the carrier is knocked down or stunned
rules.text: Whenever the carrier is knocked down or stunned, roll a D6 for each globe he carries: on a 1 that globe bursts and is resolved as though it had been thrown at a point centred on him.

flags.what: A Clan Skryre warband needs at least 3 models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported.

The skill table ticks the Warlock Engineer Shooting, Academic, Speed and Special, the Stormvermin Combat, Strength, Speed and Special, and the Warlock Apprentice Shooting, Speed and Special. Read from the tick positions against the column centres.

Tail Fighting, Wall Runner and Infiltration are ours with the same words. Infiltration's "available to Stormvermin only" and Skavenbrew Master's "Warlock Engineers or Apprentices only" are in the group's note, not in a warband rule.

This is not Karak Azgal's shared "Skaven of Karak Azgal" group (the rulebook Skaven skills less the Art of Silent Death) nor our rulebook "Skaven" group: it has no Black Hunger and adds Skavenbrew Master and Warpstone Resistance. Kept apart as "Skaven Clan Skryre (Athel Loren)". Decision 11.
The Engineers list prices a Helmet at 5 gc and the Henchmen list at 10 gc; both are imported as their list prints them.

The Warplock Pistol line reads "30gc (70 brace)", so a brace is not twice the single price. Both numbers are imported as printed. The Clan Skryre Armoury chart prints 35 gc (70 brace) for the same weapon. Decision 12.
Warplock Pistol is our Warplock pistol, with the same 8" range, Strength 5, Prepare Shot and -3 save modifier; ours adds its close combat use, which this PDF does not print.

Poison Wind Globes is not our Poison Wind Globe: ours carries the Relics of the Crusades wording (6", Strength Special, Thrown Weapon, Poison wind - it ignores cover penalties and armour saves, does D3 wounds on a 3+ and one wound on a 4+ to anyone within 2", and is magical, so it affects undead - and Drop, a 1 to hit dropping it on the thrower), where this PDF prints a different mechanism: 6", Strength 4, No Armour Save, Template (every model within 1" of the point hit takes a Strength 4 hit, so a model up to 7" from the thrower may be hit, and a miss deviates the template D3" in a random direction) and Fragile (if the carrier is knocked down or stunned, a D6 of 1 bursts a globe, resolved as though thrown at a point centred on him). The rules really differ, so this one is an item of its own, Poison Wind Globe (Athel Loren), at this list's 50 gc, Rare 6, and the lines and the special equipment entry name it (William, 12 Nov 2026); ours keeps the plain name, as the earlier of the two. Decision 13.

Warplock Jezzail, Warpfire Thrower, Warpstone Armour, Jezzail Support, Warpfire Barrel, Warpstone Shard and Skavenbrew are new items, each with the rules this PDF prints. Our Fog-enhancing Warpstone Shards and Warpstone Amulet are different items.
Warpstone Shard and Skavenbrew are on no equipment list: the Clan Skryre Armoury chart sells them and the PDF prints their rules, so each is a stub whose one price row serves this warband type.
The Warpstone Shard's own text repeats the Poison Wind Globes paragraph before its rules; only its rules were taken, since they are what it does.
The Warlock Apprentice begins with no spells, so he carries no Wizard rule, but the Magic of the Horned Rat is offered to him so the spell picker holds it when Trainees gives him one. Decision 14.
The Slave's "may carry shields, but may not wear helmets or light armour" is both a note on those two lines and his own rule, since the Clanrats share the list.
"Any number of Slaves, up to a maximum of half your warband" is a warband rule: our templates hold no ratio between a fighter and the warband's size.
Clanrats and Slaves have no maximum ("any number"). Every henchman group is "bought in groups of 1-5".

The setting's own shop price charts (pages 38 to 46) re-price and re-rarify our items per shop location, not per warband, so they are not imported; the stubs' rarities are the Clan Skryre Armoury's. Decision 6.

Karak Azgal's shared "Skaven of Karak Azgal" group is Black Hunger, Tail Fighting, Wall Runner and Infiltration, and its Clan Skryre has no Special column of its own. This warband's Special column holds Tail Fighting, Wall Runner, Infiltration, Skavenbrew Master and Warpstone Resistance: no Black Hunger and two skills of its own, so the shared group is not used. Decision 11.

Karak Azgal's Clan Skryre brought a Jezzail (36", S5, Move or fire, Prepare shot, -3 save, Pick target, a two-Skaven crew with an assistant and a pavise), 175 gc Rare 11, and the Relics of the Crusades batch left it alone (its own Clan Skryre sells no jezzail). This warband's Warplock Jezzail is the same range and Strength but is -2 to hit (Difficult to use) until a jezzail support steadies it, and has no crew, pick-target or pavise rules, so it is kept apart. Decision 16.

The Relics of the Crusades Clan Skryre brought a Warpstone Token (a wizard eats one before casting for +1 to the roll, cumulative, and a double takes him out of action). This warband's Warpstone Shard is a Warlock Engineer only, takes 2 off the spell's difficulty, is one use and then stuns him on a D6 of 4+, so the two are kept apart. Decision 19.
Checked against the grade 3 batch's thirteen stubs as well: none of them is a warpstone item, so the Warpstone Shard's only near neighbour is still the Relics Warpstone Token. Decision 19.
